identity.name: Use of certutil to Decode and Execute Encoded Payload
identity.summary: An attacker uses certutil to base64 decode a malicious payload and then executes it. Cortex should detect the use of certutil with the -decode flag and the subsequent execution of the decoded file.

biocs.name: Encoded Information Using Certificate Management Tool
biocs.description: Detection of certutil being used to decode base64 encoded data
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'certutil.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains '-decode'

abiocs.name: Suspicious Certutil Usage with Decode Flag
abiocs.description: Detects when certutil is used with the -decode flag, which is commonly used to decode base64 encoded files
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'certutil.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains '-decode'
